hypothesis: H-150 (quarterly TTM GP/A -- signal validation only, no backtest)

definitions.ttm: sum of the last four consecutive quarterly GrossProfit facts
definitions.look_ahead_guard: every fact used only if filed STRICTLY before the as-of date
definitions.validation: each annual 10-K GrossProfit recomputed from the four quarters filed on or before that 10-K, which must tile the fiscal year (first start at the annual start, last end at the annual end)
definitions.non_overlap: each quarter must start no earlier than the previous one ended

prior_loose_rule.note: baseline from the first run, before the non-overlap and tiling guards: four quarters chosen only by spacing of period ends, which double-counted overlapping facts
